label: GO step, choosing a1 after a rare a1 trial (a1 -> S2), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2) and almost only when the agent chooses a1 (95% of mass; model_act==1, choice logit strongly positive). The strongest context is a previous trial where a1 led rarely to S2 (prev_common==0 rate 3.2x lift, 79% of mass), especially when that trial went unrewarded (rare-unrewarded, so the model-based response is to stay with a1). The top activations are all the GO right after a1 -> S2 rare -> r0 while S1 is good. It is also strongly tied to episode time: it is silent before about trial 40 and grows through trials 60-90, and it is stronger when value is moderate rather than high. On the first trial of a window, where previous-trial info is unknown, it also fires (not captured). It does not fire for a2 choices, after common transitions, or early in the episode. Recorded predicate uses only observed history plus the agent s own GO choice; dev F1 0.63, mass recall 0.73. Dropping the reward condition raises recall; adding prev_reward==0 sharpens the top quartile.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S2 u, a1 S2 r, a2 S2 u) and trial before (GO: a1 S2 u, a1 S2 r, a1 S1 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
